data.narrative:
Qilimanjaro is a Series A quantum computing company that has raised $10M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public peers (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private companies including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable to this valuation. Using total raised of $10M as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $20M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable; while 8 same-sector private peers exist, insufficient datapoints meet narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) to support a reliable median—fewer than the three minimum comparables required.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $17M (low) to $23M (high), centered on $20M. This range reflects conservative and optimistic variants of stage-progression methodology applied to the single available anchor. Key uncertainties include the lack of sufficiently comparable peer financials at the same stage and tier, which limits cross-validation. Any valuation relying on this single method carries elevated sensitivity to the 2.0x multiplier assumption and the $10M base proxy. Investors should treat this range as preliminary and subject to refinement as later-stage financing or comparable transaction data emerge.
